answer.rationale: Renewal is the only current path that protects uninterrupted supply with the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer. Switching could support the 18% spend mandate, but a prior quick onboarding does not establish that migration can be completed safely within 14 days; verify memory_c2 to test that assumption before committing. Incumbent renewal preserves delivery continuity, although its cost impact remains unfavorable and should be revisited next cycle.
